title: Conway polyhedron operators
purpose: Build polyhedra from Conway notation: dual, ambo, kis, truncate, join, expand, ortho, gyro and snub applied to T, C, O, D, I, prisms and antiprisms, with planarizing relaxation. Use it for geodesic forms and gems.

entry_points.name: seed
entry_points.summary: Seed polyhedron (vertices on the unit sphere, outward faces): T, C, O, D, I, Pn or An (n >= 3).

entry_points.name: dual
entry_points.summary: Dual: one vertex per face (its centroid on the unit sphere), one face per vertex (its faces in order).

entry_points.name: ambo
entry_points.summary: Ambo (rectify): one vertex per edge midpoint; a face for each old face and each old vertex.

entry_points.name: kis
entry_points.summary: Kis: raise a vertex over every face centre and replace the face with a fan of triangles.

entry_points.name: gyro
entry_points.summary: Gyro: every n-gon becomes n pentagons around a new centre, with two new vertices on each edge.

entry_points.name: apply_operator
entry_points.summary: One operator: d dual, a ambo, k kis, j join (da), t truncate (dkd), e expand (aa), o ortho (dad... de), g gyro, s snub (dg).

entry_points.name: conway
entry_points.summary: The polyhedron for a Conway notation string, as a closed mesh with polygon faces on about the unit sphere.

entry_points.name: build
entry_points.summary: The flat-shaded polyhedron the command line writes, each face coloured by its number of corners.

entry_points.name: main
entry_points.summary: Command line: write the polyhedron as .gltf or .obj and print a JSON summary.

parameters.name: notation
parameters.meaning: Operators read right to left, then a seed: T C O D I, Pn (prism) or An (antiprism), for example tI, sC, dkD.

parameters.name: relax
parameters.meaning: Planarizing iterations after each operator (0 keeps raw centroids on the unit sphere).

contract.complexity: O(size of the result) per operator, plus relax * faces

outputs.content: the flat-shaded polyhedron with COLOR_0 by face size (triangle, square, pentagon, hexagon)
the same polyhedron as Wavefront OBJ

limits: Geometry is approximate: new points start at centroids on the unit sphere and the relaxation only makes faces nearly planar; it does not produce canonical forms with equal edge lengths. Snub and gyro results are one of two mirror images.
technique_references: Conway polyhedron notation (dual, ambo, kis, gyro and compositions)
Face cycles around vertices from directed edges
